name: Transport Driving Learner Permit
description: Apply for a driving learning license from the Transport Authority of the Transport Authority (ITS Demo Scenario 2). Flat 6 EUR service fee. The system fetches the eye-test result from the approved-opticians registry by civil number and checks the terms of service by DMN (age 18+, 21+ for heavy/mechanical, no existing valid license, GCC citizens need a resident card, special-needs category limits). Weak vision routes to a Police Hospital medical assessment. After approval and payment, the electronic learning license with the payment receipt is issued and emailed.

variables.title: transportLearningPermit start-time variables
variables.description: Variables collected from the applicant at start time. The engine sets `initiator` from the authenticated user automatically; never include it in start_process input. The applicant's full name and email are filled automatically from their signed-in Keycloak account at process start — do NOT ask for them and do NOT send them (they are not accepted here, and the engine re-validates them on task completion).

civilId.description: civil number, exactly 8 digits. Drives the eye-test lookup. Demo IDs: 90000001 weak vision (hospital branch), 90000002 failed eye test, 90000003 no eye test on file, 90000004 already holds a valid license, 90000005 outstanding restrictions; anything else is all-clear.

age.description: Age in years. Under 18 is always rejected; under 21 cannot apply for heavy-vehicle or mechanical-equipment.

residencyStatus.description: GCC-country citizens must hold a resident card.

hasResidentCard.description: Whether the applicant holds a valid resident card (required for GCC citizens).

specialNeeds.description: Special-needs applicants are not eligible for heavy-vehicle, mechanical-equipment, or motorcycle categories.

profession.description: Optional. For residents, the license category must match the profession registered with the Ministry of Labor (informational in the POC). Pass an empty string when unknown.

userTasks.name: Apply for a learning permit
userTasks.description: The applicant confirms the learning permit application. The applicant's name and email are filled automatically from their signed-in account — do NOT collect or send them. There is no send-back loop in this service.

userTasks.name: Police Hospital medical assessment
userTasks.description: The hospital medical board (played by the civil-servant group) records whether the weak-vision applicant is fit to drive. Negative results compose rejectionReason from the notes; positive results pass an empty rejectionReason.

medicalResult.description: positive = fit to drive, proceed to fee payment. negative = reject the application.

medicalNotes.description: Required (non-empty) when negative — sent to the applicant as the reason.

rejectionReason.description: Computed: 'Police Hospital medical assessment: <notes>' when negative, empty string when positive.
